hand_chosen.title: Periodic timing variation (a companion, or light-travel time)

trail.text: 158 published mid-times, Yee et al. 2020 (ApJL 888, L5); times from BJD_TDB (±60 s).
Proposed 5 laws: Constant velocity (no net force), Constant acceleration, Tidal orbital decay - constant dP/dt, Decay plus sinusoidal TTV from companion or precession, Evolving decay rate with jerk.

The motion looks like noise: no candidate law explains more than 1% of the measured acceleration, the velocity's spectrum is flat (0.51, where 1 is white noise), and no smooth trend explains the track (87%). Simulation fits were skipped.
